content.title: THE CLÁSICO TAPATÍO RETURNS TO LOS ANGELES - BMO Stadium
content.text: A Five-Hour Tapatío Fest will culminate with the thrilling match between Chivas de Guadalajara and Atlas F.C. at BMO Stadium Los Angeles, CA (January 16, 2026) – PRIMETIME Sports, Chivas de Guadalajara, Atlas F.C., and BMO Stadium announced today that the Clásico Tapatío is returning to Los Angeles with the Guadalajara derby between Chivas de Guadalajara and Atlas F.C. at BMO Stadium on Sunday, March 29 at 6:30 p.m. PT. Both teams begin the Clausura 2026 with several additions to their rosters. Guadalajara added young star Brian Gutiérrez and Liga MX veteran Angel Sepulveda, while Ricardo Marín returns to the squad. Atlas F.C. strengthened their roster with international signings Rodrigo Schlegel and Gustavo Ferrareis, along with Mexican midfielder Arturo González. The Clásico Tapatío is Mexico’s oldest rivalry that has existed for over a century dating back to 1916. Both teams boast large fan bases, and their passionate rivalry is seen and felt beyond borders. The last time these two teams played at this stadium the game ended in a draw in front of a sold-out crowd in March, 2024. The excitement and passion around the 2026 summer of soccer is strongly felt, and in honor of all Angelenos with ties to Jalisco, a five-hour Tapatío Fest will take place prior to the game outside the stadium. Fans will be able to enjoy the biggest Guadalajara-themed party the city has ever seen with live music, birria, tortas ahogadas, trophies, club legends, and much more. Please register for the pre-sale at www.clasicotapatio.com. The ticket pre-sale will take place on Wednesday, January 21, at 10:00 a.m. PT. Tickets will be available to the public starting on Thursday, January 22, at 10:00 a.m. PT at ticketmaster.com, and ticketon.com. For media credentials, please visit https://ptimesports.co/clasicotapatio2026. For any other media-related inquiries, please send an e-mail to media@ptimesports.com.
